newsitem.title: USA: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE TRADE AT STANDSTILL - USDA.
newsitem.headline: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE TRADE AT STANDSTILL - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area early Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting fairly good inquiry from buyers. The last established market was $64.00 per cwt on Friday. Tuesday's packer bids were $63.00-$64.00, with asking prices $65.00 to mostly $66.00.
There were 36,200 head sold for the week to date including 27,500 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink. Confirmed - None
